GenAiFunction.description: Classify the veteran's background into one of the nine Next Mission career clusters, grounded in NM_Specialty_Cluster__mdt at runtime. Pass userDescription — the veteran's own description of their experience. Returns found=true and clusterKey if a valid cluster is identified. Returns found=false and narrowingQuestion if classification failed. When found=false: surface narrowingQuestion verbatim. Do not ask what a typical day looked like again — the veteran already answered. Call this action again with their clarification as userDescription.
